answer: Stop sybils with a shale tundra ledger: an agent stakes a bond for one tundra plot marked by a willow. Each cycle it adds one shale layer stacked on the last; verifiers void a layer copied, out of order, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots and layers at 16x each: each shale layer fits one willow plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim one tundra plot and keep rights.
